---
title: "CSI bidding strategy by state (R)"
output: html_document
---

R twin of the dashboard's `state_summary()` (page 9) and `2026-06-15_state_analysis.ipynb`. Bids per
state, win/loss, margins, competitive intensity, and job-type mix by state. Win = CSI's own bid
ranked 1st (row-derived, 117/603). Reads the derived base table only.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(scales)})
BASE <- "/Users/t/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/00 MSBA + Coding/00_summer 2026/00_CSI_ELP/01_Summer_2026"
OUT  <- file.path(BASE, "02_modules/sweet_spot/outputs")
df <- read.csv(file.path(OUT, "2026-06-04_project_base.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$Project_Size_Dollars <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$Project_Size_Dollars))
df$CSI_Margin_Pct <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$CSI_Margin_Pct))
df$Num_Valid_Bidders <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$Num_Valid_Bidders))
bid <- df %>% mutate(
  is_bid = toupper(trimws(CSI_Participated))=="TRUE",
  is_win = toupper(trimws(CSI_Won))=="TRUE",
  is_win_well = CSI_Bid_Quality %in% c("Excellent Win","Acceptable Win"),
  is_bomb = CSI_Bid_Quality=="Bomb") %>% filter(is_bid)
cat(sprintf("CSI bids: %d | wins: %d\n", nrow(bid), sum(bid$is_win)))
```

### State scorecard

```{r scorecard}
ss <- bid %>% group_by(State) %>% summarise(
  n_bid=n(), n_won=sum(is_win), n_lost=n()-sum(is_win),
  win_pct=round(mean(is_win)*100,1), win_well_pct=round(mean(is_win_well)*100,1),
  bomb_pct=round(mean(is_bomb)*100,1), portfolio=sum(Project_Size_Dollars[is_win], na.rm=TRUE),
  avg_size=round(mean(Project_Size_Dollars, na.rm=TRUE)), med_margin=round(median(CSI_Margin_Pct, na.rm=TRUE),3),
  avg_bidders=round(mean(Num_Valid_Bidders, na.rm=TRUE),1), .groups="drop") %>% arrange(desc(n_bid))
print(as.data.frame(ss))
```

### Win rate & competitive intensity by state

```{r charts, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
STATE <- c("Minnesota"="#1f4e79","North Dakota"="#2c7fb8","South Dakota"="#66a61e",
           "Iowa"="#e67e22","Nebraska"="#7b3294","Montana"="#999999")
ggplot(ss, aes(reorder(State,-win_pct), win_pct, fill=State)) + geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept=19.4, linetype="dotted") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=STATE, guide="none") +
  labs(title="Win rate by state (dotted = overall 19.4%)", x=NULL, y="Win %") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=20, hjust=1))
```

### Archetype mix by state (% of bids)

```{r archmix, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
arch <- read.csv(file.path(OUT, "2026-06-04_project_archetypes.csv"), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
bid2 <- left_join(bid, arch[,c("Contract_Id","rule_archetype")], by="Contract_Id")
bid2 %>% count(State, rule_archetype) %>% group_by(State) %>% mutate(pct=n/sum(n)*100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(State, pct, fill=rule_archetype)) + geom_col() +
  labs(title="Archetype mix by state (% of bids)", x=NULL, y="% of bids", fill="archetype") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=20, hjust=1))
```

## Takeaway
MN (268 bids) and ND (218) dominate the book; SD bids are far larger on average. Interactive version:
dashboard page 9.
